title: Chelsea Women vs Roma: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info | News | Official Site
text:
Chelsea Women vs Roma: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info | News | Official Site | Chelsea Football Club 
 Chelsea's UEFA Women's Champions League campaign continues when Italian side Roma come to west London. 
 The Blues remain unbeaten in continental competition this season after two matches of the league phase and will be looking to make it back-to-back home wins in the Champions League as European football returns to the top of the agenda in midweek.
 Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Roma, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels.
 When and where is Chelsea Women vs Roma?
 Chelsea Women's game against Roma takes place on Wednesday 28 October 2026 at Plough Lane, with kick-off scheduled for 5.45pm UK time.
 Tickets for the game remain on sale. 
 How to watch Chelsea Women vs Roma: Live stream details
 If you can't make it to Plough Lane, then you can watch the match live on Disney+.
 As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Roma Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website .
 You can also follow Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X , Facebook , Instagram and TikTok .
 The form
 Chelsea are yet to lose in this season's Champions League and have a 100 per cent record on home soil at Plough Lane. We opened our league phase campaign in west London with a 1-0 win over Austria Vienna, Wieke Kaptein getting the only goal of the game, before a goalless draw away at eight-time European champions Lyon last time out.
 Our opponents, on the other hand, come to these shores looking for their first win of the league phase, although they have won three in a row domestically in Serie A. In Europe, Roma started with a 0-0 draw against Leuven away in Belgium, but were then humbled by a 6-0 home defeat to Barcelona.
 Recent head-to-head
 Chelsea are hosting Roma in the league phase of the Champions League for the second season in a row, although last term's meeting at Stamford Bridge was the first-ever between these two sides. On that occasion it was a one-sided affair, with Kaptein, Johanna Rytting Kaneryd, Sjoeke Nusken , Maika Hamano and Lucy Bronze all getting on the scoresheet, after an own goal had given us the lead, in a 6-0 victory for the Blues.
 That was the only game Roma have ever played against English opposition, while Chelsea are unbeaten in five games against Italian teams, with fours wins and one draw, plus 15 goals scored to one against. We have never conceded at home to a Serie A side.
